_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/costs/test_put_counters_cost.py. Never part of a deck list. t_pc_tome is Mazemind Tome's first line with a plainer effect: {T}, put a page counter on this artifact: gain 1 life. t_pc_battery puts two charge counters and taps nothing, so it can be activated repeatedly. t_pc_naive_tome is deliberately the WRONG card: the version the DSL could write before `put_counters` was a cost, with the counter moved into the effects, asserted against as the counterfactual. t_pc_watcher is a permanent that gains 1 life whenever counters are put on it.
